mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing cenobamate exposure and CNS depressant effects; cenobamate may induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing clarithromycin efficacy.
action: Monitor for increased cenobamate adverse effects (dizziness, ataxia, cognitive impairment); consider alternative antibiotic or dose adjustment; assess therapeutic clarithromycin efficacy.
